question: How do I apply for an SCF Build Award — what is the step-by-step application process?

golden.answer: Submit the interest form on communityfund.stellar.org. If you are eligible, SCF invites you to submit a full proposal to one Build track (Open, Integration or RFP) by that round's deadline. The proposal goes through prescreen, panel review and possible revision; only Open Track projects get a community vote. Selected teams complete KYC/KYB, accept the award and receive milestone-based payments.
keyFacts: Applicants start with an interest form on communityfund.stellar.org.
Eligible applicants are invited to submit a full Open, Integration or RFP proposal.
Review runs prescreen, panel review, possible revision, then an Open-Track-only vote.
KYC/KYB is required before milestone-based payments.
avoid: Do NOT present the SDF Enterprise Fund application as the SCF Build path.
golden.notes: The awards page says rounds run about every six weeks, but 2026 deadlines were 5 to 12 weeks apart; do not require a fixed cadence, per-stage durations or a results week.

sources.note: 'Submit the SCF Interest form and indicate your interest in the Open Track.' 'Eligible teams will be invited to submit to an upcoming Build round.'
